mapper.select: SELECT fb.basket_id, fb.prod_id, fp.product_name as prodName, fp.product_list_picture_url as prodPic, fp.ori_price as price, fb.sku_id, ts.colour, ts.weight, ts.weight, fb.user_id, fb.basket_count, fb.basket_date, fb.status FROM folwer_basket fb LEFT JOIN folwer_product fp ON fb.prod_id = fp.id LEFT JOIN folwer_sku ts ON fb.sku_id = ts.sku_id WHERE fb.del_flag=0 AND fb.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY fb.`basket_id` DESC
